title: Food Hazard Detection
description: Food safety hazard detection task requiring annotators to classify short food-incident report texts by hazard-category and product-category (coarse labels), and to identify the specific hazard and product mentions (fine-grained labels). Based on SemEval-2025 Task 9: The Food Hazard Detection Challenge.
